added_failures_note: The reviewed run carried no armed suite pair (its dispatch declared FENCE SUITE unarmed: no test file lay in its write scope), so it records no baseline_suite/after_suite block. The only recorded suite evidence is gate-worker-behaviour.log at 77cedb1dd: 7 passed, EXIT=0. No failing test id is recorded against the head, so the added count is 0 and the id list is empty.

findings.summary: behaviour_role defaults to 'implement' and no production call site supplies it, so every review launch records review_duty=True and landing_treatment='promoted-under-its-lane'.
findings.text: behaviour_role defaults to 'implement' and no production call site supplies it, so every review launch records review_duty=True and landing_treatment='promoted-under-its-lane'. node.role is already carried at reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:839 and reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:1608; wiring it here is what makes the role-keyed fact true.

findings.summary: a live clive run now has a seeded run home and inbox hook, but the peer-message reachability test still branches on dialect == 'claude', so delivery to a clive run is refused by name.
findings.text: a live clive run now has a seeded run home and inbox hook, but the peer-message reachability test still branches on dialect == 'claude', so delivery to a clive run is refused by name. This is the §12 row at crew_run_commands.py:3003 and it is the counterpart of the seeding this node repaired; the composed fact inbox_trigger='run-home-hook' is therefore not reachable through the command that delivers.

findings.summary: the equality gate composes with fence=False, so fence_protections and write_roots are empty for every backend and their equality is asserted trivially.
findings.text: the equality gate composes with fence=False, so fence_protections and write_roots are empty for every backend and their equality is asserted trivially. Two of the dimensions §16 names are therefore not exercised; a name-keyed fence difference would pass this gate.

findings.summary: flight_config is never supplied in production and the resume rebuild drops lane_document, so a resumed launch records the backend name as its lane.
findings.text: flight_config is never supplied in production and the resume rebuild drops lane_document, so a resumed launch records the backend name as its lane. reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:1089 merges only usable_input_window, model, effort and input_modalities from the configured backend, so two backends of one lane resumed would compare unequal on the lane fact while the fresh dispatch records their shared document.

findings.summary: lane_identity re-implements the lane-document resolution already held in drainer_serves_the_local_lane.
findings.text: lane_identity re-implements the lane-document resolution already held in drainer_serves_the_local_lane (reckon/crew/admission/selection.py:756-762): the same backends lookup, lane_document strip and realpath/expanduser expression now exists twice, so a change to how a lane is identified must be made in two places.

findings.summary: _seed_worker_mcp_exclusions reintroduces a filename-keyed branch inside the function the change de-named.
findings.text: _seed_worker_mcp_exclusions reintroduces a filename-keyed branch inside the function the change de-named: 'if mcp_config_file == ".claude.json"' decides whether a missing config is left alone or created, so a dialect declaring an equivalent file under another name gets omp's create-empty behaviour. A declared attribute would carry the same fact without a literal.
